messages:
rita: PROD ap-southeast1 embed service returning intermittent 504s for short payloads. Root cause looks like tokenizer crash on embedded null byte. I built a hotfix image that skips naive JSON.parse on certain inputs. Need fast-track: staging smoke then prod within 25m. @omar @sylvia please ack.
omar: Do we need schema changes? rollback plan?
rita: No schema. Rollback plan: revert to redwood/embed:v2.3.7. Hotfix image: redwood/embed:v2.3.8-hotfix-175123.
sylvia: I'll run the staging smoke and a small canary. If staging clean I can +1 for override.
deploy-bot: Policy: canary_required for service embeds. Override allowed with 2 eng + 1 SRE approval.
paul: I'll monitor infra and set alerts for ap-southeast1 5xx > 1%.
sylvia: staging smoke running (scripts/smoke_embed.sh --region ap-southeast1). TTL ~2m.
sylvia: staging smoke PASS. no 5xx in 3m. kv warm.
omar: +1 from me after smoke.
rita: Requesting expedite. Command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.3.8-hotfix-175123 --target staging --pin --override-canary --notes "hotfix: tokenizer null-byte guard"```
deploy-bot: Override flag detected. Approval log: rita/omar/sylvia. Scheduling staging deploy.
deploy-bot: staging deploy successful. sha=ff12ee. healthchecks OK.
paul: Toggling rollout: 10% prod hosts for 5m, then 50%, then 100% if stable. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 1% sustained.
rita: Rolling to prod now. Command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.3.8-hotfix-175123 --target prod --pin --rollout 100% --notes "fasttrack: null-byte tokenizer fix"```
deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. Auto-rollback threshold=1% 5xx for 2m.
oncall-sre: Monitoring live. I'll run synthetic short-payload hits.
oncall-sre: Synthetic OK. No new 5xx.
deploy-bot: Prod rollout completed successfully. No rollback triggered.
rita: Will publish release note link in 30m and keep 1h watch. Thanks all.
